description: This file defines various classes and traits for random sampling within Apache Spark, including different sampling strategies such as Bernoulli, Poisson, and gap sampling, along with utility classes for sampling with replacement and sampling without replacement.

classes.name: RandomSampler
classes.description: A trait defining the interface for pseudorandom samplers with methods for sampling items and cloning.

classes.name: BernoulliCellSampler
classes.description: A sampler based on Bernoulli trials within a specified acceptance range, with support for complement sampling.

classes.name: BernoulliSampler
classes.description: A Bernoulli trial-based sampler for a fixed sampling fraction, utilizing gap sampling for efficiency at low fractions.

classes.name: PoissonSampler
classes.description: A sampler for sampling with replacement based on Poisson distribution, with optional gap sampling optimization.

classes.name: GapSampling
classes.description: Utility class implementing gap sampling logic for Bernoulli trials, deciding whether to sample based on geometric distribution.

classes.name: GapSamplingReplacement
classes.description: Utility class for sampling with replacement using Poisson distribution conditioned to be >= 1, with gap sampling support.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Method in RandomSampler trait to take a sample from an iterator of items.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Method in RandomSampler trait to clone the sampler object.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Method to set the seed for the random number generator.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Method in BernoulliCellSampler to determine if an item should be sampled based on acceptance range.

methods.name: cloneComplement
methods.description: Returns a new BernoulliCellSampler with the complement of the current acceptance range.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Method in BernoulliSampler to perform Bernoulli sampling based on the specified fraction.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Method in PoissonSampler to determine the number of times an item is sampled, with optional gap sampling.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Method in PoissonSampler to sample items from an iterator, replicating items based on Poisson counts.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Method in GapSampling to decide whether to sample the next item based on geometric distribution.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Method in GapSampling to compute the number of items to skip before next sample.

methods.name: poissonGE1
methods.description: Method in GapSamplingReplacement to generate a Poisson-distributed value >= 1.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Method in GapSamplingReplacement to decide how many items to skip based on geometric distribution.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Method in GapSamplingReplacement to compute the number of items to skip.
